title: Computer Use Benchmark Result
description: One task run's outcome, recorded by the runner from the real session trace plus the evaluator's independent success check. The runner never asks the model whether it succeeded; success comes only from the evaluator (or an explicit human review).

model.description: Model id that drove the run (e.g. zhipuai/glm-4.6). Empty for harness=manual.

screenshot_bytes.description: Total bytes of screenshots delivered to the model (0 if the host hides them).

trace_id.description: Session id used for the run's trace (trace read requires the observation token, which the runner holds in memory only).

failure_category.description: SUCCESS when success=true. Otherwise: RUNTIME failures (GROUNDING_* through CANCEL_FAILED, SESSION_ERROR, PERMISSION_ERROR, HARNESS_INTEGRATION_ERROR) vs MODEL failures (MODEL_PLANNING_ERROR, MODEL_STOPPED_EARLY) vs harness/validation failures (SUCCESS_VALIDATION_ERROR, STATE_DETECTION_ERROR, STABILIZER_TIMEOUT, ACTION_TIMEOUT, APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND, WINDOW_SWITCH_ERROR). Category assignment rules in benchmarks/README.md.

failure_detail.description: Short human-readable root-cause excerpt (from the trace, never invented).

human_review_required.description: true when the task's criteria include human_review — the result still needs a human verdict (report lists these separately).
